title: Modded multi
subtitle: Play custom maps with friends: host or join a Rocket Plugin game over Tailscale, without Easy Anti-Cheat.
offlineNote: Modded games run without Easy Anti-Cheat (offline mode): every player needs Tailscale, BakkesMod with Rocket Plugin and the same map. The app only starts the tools you installed: it never injects anything itself.

setup.title: Before playing

tailscale.notInstalled: Not installed: every player needs it to reach the others.
tailscale.serviceDown: Installed, but its service does not answer — start Tailscale.
tailscale.needsLogin: Sign in to Tailscale (tray icon) on this PC.
tailscale.stopped: Disconnected — click Connect in the Tailscale menu.

bakkes.missing: Not installed: Rocket Plugin runs inside BakkesMod.
bakkes.ready: Installed — the app starts it for you.
bakkes.noInjector: Data folder found, but not BakkesMod.exe: start BakkesMod yourself.

rocketPlugin.missing: Not installed: add it from BakkesMod's plugin manager.
rocketPlugin.notLoaded: Installed but not loaded at start-up (plugins.cfg): enable it in BakkesMod.

rcon.label: Remote control
rcon.ready: BakkesMod accepts Rocket Plugin commands from this app (local port {{port}}, random password).
rcon.off: Off: the app will show the command to type in the BakkesMod console. Enabled automatically when you host or join with the game closed.
rcon.restart: Restart the game so BakkesMod picks it up.

game.label: Rocket League
game.closed: Closed — it will be started without EAC.
game.eac: Running with EAC: close it first.

setup.noPeers: No other device on your tailnet yet.

host.title: Host a game
host.description: Installs the map, starts the game and BakkesMod, opens the game on Rocket Plugin, then gives you a code for your friends.
host.noMaps: Your map library is empty: add a map in Maps first.

join.title: Join a friend
join.description: Paste the code from the host: the app installs the same map, starts the game and BakkesMod, then joins.
join.autoDownload: Downloaded from bakkesplugins if you do not have it.
join.needsFile: Imported map: you need the same file in your library (ask the host).

session.invite: Invite code — send it to your friends
session.manual: Type this in the BakkesMod console (F6)
session.again: Command (to type in the BakkesMod console if nothing happened)
session.hostDone: Your game should be loading. Change the mode or mutators in Rocket Plugin's window if needed; friends can join with the code.
session.joinDone: You should be loading into the host's game. If it times out, check the host is in the game and that Tailscale shows them online.
session.mismatch: Your copy of this map is not the host's exact file: the game may refuse to connect (content mismatch). Get the same file from the host.

security.title: Lock Tailscale down to the game
security.intro: By default every device on a tailnet can reach every port of the others. For gaming you only need Rocket League's port: replace the tailnet policy so nothing else goes through.

tips.acl: In the Tailscale admin console (Access controls), replace the policy with the one below and put every player's Tailscale login in group:rl. Only UDP 7777 between players is allowed; everything else is denied.
tips.noSsh: "ssh": [] removes Tailscale SSH. Never run tailscale up --ssh on a gaming PC.
tips.noRoutes: Do not advertise an exit node or subnet routes: friends then only see your PC, not your home network.
tips.firewall: When Windows asks about Rocket League, allow it on Private networks only.
tips.cleanup: Remove a friend's device (Machines) when you stop playing together, and keep device approval on.
